intro: A financial analyst resume that shows forecasts, models and the decisions they informed, with the sums involved.
tips: Give the size of the budgets or deals you worked on.
List modelling skills and systems, and any CFA progress.

basics.name: James Whitfield
basics.label: Financial Analyst
basics.summary: Financial analyst with five years in FP&A at a retail group. I build models that leadership plans with, and explain the numbers behind them.

work.name: Harbour Retail Group
highlights: Own the annual budget and monthly forecast for a £120m division.
Built the store-level profitability model used to decide 14 closures and 6 openings.
Cut month-end reporting from eight days to four by automating consolidations.

work.name: Grant & Co.
highlights: Built valuation models for eight mid-market acquisitions, from £5m to £40m.
Prepared board packs and variance analysis for three clients.
